tagline: Alerts from your servers, in your pocket
help:
Sign in once; the key is stored in {path}.
Typing a long key is tedious: copy it over SSH or install the CLI and run `{command}`.

email.title: Sign in
email.note: Enter edits a field. Accounts with 2FA ask for a code next. The device gets its own API key named "{name}".

twoFactor.title: Two-factor code
twoFactor.hint: 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

error.deviceKeyFailed: Could not create a device key
